nodes.name: 衔晓张翅
nodes.light: a blinding white-gold dawn bursting from the far end of the bridge and filling the gorge, every shadow thrown straight back toward us, bone walls bleached white
nodes.camera: low on the bridge head behind the two of them, the light pouring straight into the lens between them, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: afternoon deep underground, at the near head of a natural bridge of bone that spans a gorge whose walls are fused bone. From the far end of the bridge a dawn has just broken that does not belong underground: a spread of white-gold light shaped like two enormous wings opening, too bright to look into, with no bird and no face to be seen inside it, only the light. The whole gorge is lit from end to end, and the shadow of every rib and ledge on the walls has swung round to point away from the bridge. At the bridge head, in full profile facing right toward the light, stands the lilac-haired surveyor, a half-elf of thirty-two with misty lilac hair cut straight at the chin: both her hands hold a long measuring pole upright toward the brightness, and her eyes are wide open and fixed on it, her mouth slack. Along the outpost wall behind her five soldiers stand in the same way with their faces lifted to the light, quite still. Beside her, seen directly from behind, stands the blind white-haired swordsman, an old lean man with long white hair tied at the back, a strip of cloth bound over his eyes, a sheathed sword in his right hand used like a cane: his head is turned a little aside, listening, and his left hand, a small brass bell tied at its wrist, has caught the back of her collar. Four people sit against the wall with their backs to the bridge and their heads down. White motes and long thin shadows streak large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头头一手（源稿第198行）：午后她在桥头举起探杆，衔晓张开了翅膀，骨谷从第四十一层亮到第四十九层，谷壁上的影子一齐倒向两头。看过它本身的人只会朝着它照第196、197行，背对着桥坐着的四个照第196行。文森特左手腕上的铜铃照第195行。衔晓只画一片翅形的光，不画鸟、不画脸。文森特拽她后领是我补的。

nodes.name: 左手搭栏
who: the old halfling with the brush
nodes.light: a hard white glare at the far end of the bridge, the near side behind a ridge of bone in blue shadow, a thin bright edge on the walking figure
nodes.camera: from behind the bone ridge at the height of the halfling's shoulder, past the two who wait, along the bridge at the swordsman walking into the glare, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early morning deep underground at a bridge of bone across a gorge. A white glare stands at the far end of the bridge, too bright to look into. On the near side a low ridge of bone crosses the bridge head like a wall, and behind it three people wait in its shadow. In the middle, sitting on the ground and facing us with her back against the ridge, is the lilac-haired surveyor, a half-elf with misty lilac hair cut straight at the chin: her eyes are open and blank, a whiteness over them, and though the ridge is at her back her head keeps trying to turn toward the bridge. Behind her shoulder, in full profile facing left with his back to the bridge, the old halfling with the brush, a small grey man of sixty-two with a stiff boot brush stuck in his belt, grips her shoulder hard with his right hand and keeps his own eyes shut, his left hand flat on the bone. At the bridge rail, small, a salt trader holds an iron scale weight pressed against the rail. Beyond the ridge, on the bridge itself, seen directly from behind, the blind white-haired swordsman is walking away from us into the glare: long white hair tied at the back, a strip of cloth bound over his eyes, a sword in his right hand whose grip is wound with two turns of cloth and whose pommel ring is empty; his left hand rests lightly on the bridge rail, sliding along it as he goes. He walks upright and unhurried. White motes and bone dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕幕终（源稿第216行）：下旬三日一早，萝珊坐在骨脊后头，脸朝着桥，提珀背对着桥攥着她的肩，莫特拿秤砣抵着桥栏；文森特左手搭上桥栏，往前走了。剑上那两圈布、空着的环照收束第232行。萝珊已经瞎了照第206行，头会往回转照第204行。

nodes.name: 末声鸟鸣
nodes.light: a shapeless bank of white-gold dawn light resting on the middle of the bridge straight ahead of him, bleaching the bone rails white and throwing his shadow back toward us; deep indigo chasm below and behind
nodes.camera: on the bridge a few paces behind his left shoulder at the height of his hand on the rail, looking past him into the light, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bottomless chasm deep underground, crossed by one long narrow bridge made of great bones bound joint to joint, with a railing of upright bones. Ahead, on the middle of the bridge, lies a broad shapeless mass of dawn light with no outline and no face, wider than it is tall, in which the dim shape of one outstretched wing of light is torn and ragged; the bone rails near it have been scorched white. Long fresh clefts run down the chasm walls on both sides from the height of the bridge into the dark. On the bridge, in the middle of the picture, stands the blind white-haired swordsman, seen directly from behind and a little from his left: tall, thin and long-limbed, long white hair with a blue tinge tied back with a leather cord, an old deep-blue cloak scorched black along its right side. His left hand rests on a bone of the railing, fingertips spread, feeling it; his right arm holds a long sword raised straight up, a thin line of pale crystal glowing along the spine of the blade, held still at the top of the stroke. His head is tilted a little to the left, listening. Round the grip of the sword two turns of faded blue cloth leave one small empty loop. Far behind us at the bridge head, small, a few people crouch with their backs to the light, and one of them holds an iron weight ready to knock on the rail. Scorched flakes of bone and motes of light drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第180行那一条）：鸟叫剩了最后一种，桥栏不震了，他把剑举起来等了一下，砍下去。画举着等的那一下。左手摸着桥栏听方位、斗篷烤焦了半边、桥栏烧成了白的、谷壁添了透风的口子照第四、五拍。衔晓原文只有像天亮、热、鸟叫，画成不成形的一片晨光，缺了一边翅膀，不画圆，不画脸。

nodes.name: 环还空着
who: the old halfling with the brush
nodes.light: ordinary dim lantern light on a bridge of bone, the far end dark and quiet now, warm on hands and on a worn sword grip
nodes.camera: low on the bridge deck at the height of the sword hilt, close on the two turns of cloth and the empty ring, the two living faces above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground on a natural bridge of bone across a gorge, lit only by lanterns now; the far end of the bridge is dark and still, and a line of people with baskets of grain on their backs is crossing in both directions and meeting in the middle. At the middle of the bridge an old man sits against a rail post, seen directly from behind, upright, long white hair tied at the back, his head resting on the post as if asleep; people pass grain baskets along at his feet without disturbing him. His right hand, resting on his knee, still holds a sword: its grip is wound with two turns of worn cloth, and the ring on its pommel is empty. Crouching beside that hand, in full profile facing right, the old halfling with the brush, a small grey man of sixty-two, has taken the end of the cloth between the finger and thumb of his right hand and stopped, his left hand holding a stiff brush that he does not use; his mouth is pressed shut. Standing over him, facing us, the lilac-haired surveyor, a half-elf with misty lilac hair cut straight at the chin, looks down at the sword hilt with clear eyes, seeing it for the first time; a smear of charcoal marks the back of her right hand, which is pressed to her mouth, and her left hand holds a lantern. At both ends of the bridge, small, soldiers and camp folk are embracing. Lantern motes and grain chaff drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三拍（源稿第231、232行）：粮当场过桥，两头的人在他坐着的那根桥栏跟前碰了面，粮从他脚边过；剑还握着，那两圈布还缠着，环还空着；提珀蹲下去解布，解不动，说长到一块了，刷不下来，也不该刷；萝珊头一回看见。萝珊手背上一道炭灰照第230行。文森特画成靠着桥栏坐着的背影，不画脸。

nodes.name: 线头在手
nodes.light: one lantern on a camp pole in a dark cavern, warm on three faces and on a white line running away into blackness
nodes.camera: at the height of his open hand, close on the line end being laid in his palm, the cup on the stake beside it, the white line stretching away behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the last camp before the deep, a ring of iron stakes with lanterns in a great dark cavern, a wall of standing fog beyond. On a camp stool by one of the stakes sits the old map-maker, facing us: a tall thin man, messy dark hair shot through with silver held back at the temples by two small bronze clips, one eye a blank white glass, a rolled chart across his knees. His left hand is moving a tin cup of wine from one side of the stake head to the other. His right hand lies open on his knee, palm up, and into it the coral-braided young woman, twenty-four, compact and strong, coral-pink hair in one thick braid, kneeling in full profile facing left, is laying the end of a white cord with both her hands; the cord runs from a chalk-line box at her hip away across the cavern floor and into the fog, taut. His fingers are just closing on it. On the other side of the stake, in full profile facing right, the barefoot half-orc, sixty, both temples shaved and a strip of short brick-red mane on top, stands with a wine jug still tilted in his right hand, his bare toes spread on the stone, frowning at where his cup has been moved to. Behind them, small, four sixteen-year-olds in black-trimmed jackets set down a stack of line boxes, and a night-wing woman tests a rope with her wing claw. Lantern moths and chalk dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第479行）：长曦月中旬十日夜里，最后锚点；杜戈倒了头一杯搁在桩头上，搁在北边，奥尔文把杯子挪到西南边，说北边是放图的；瑞秋把线头放进他手心，他攥住。他认不出北、在最后锚点坐着攥线照单子第475行。黑曜誓约四个十六岁的见习照第478行，茜薇照第469行。

nodes.name: 拓名
who: the horned woman with the chisel
nodes.light: a flat brass-coloured light with no source over a city of gears, cold white on a sheet of cloth, a black seal lifted against the glow
nodes.camera: low on the edge of the calibration table beside her rubbing hand, looking up at the sealed figure standing over her, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a hall in a city made of brass gears, wheels as big as town gates turning slowly in the walls, everything lit by a flat brass-coloured glow. In the middle stands a calibration table bigger than a house, and on it brass arms have set down a tall stone slab cut with columns of names. On the edge of the table stands a figure a head taller than any man, in a long coat hung with a string of seals on its chest; its face has been smeared flat with seal paste so that there are no features at all, and in its raised right hand it holds a black seal, about to stamp the air. On the table at its feet, kneeling in full profile facing right, the coral-braided young woman, twenty-four, coral-pink hair in one thick braid, has spread a white cloth over the stone slab: her left hand holds the cloth flat and her right hand scrubs a stick of charcoal across it, and line after line of the names is coming up on the cloth. She does not look up. Below the table, facing us, the horned woman with the chisel, a tall bull-horned demon-kin woman, has her left hand on the table edge and a short chisel in her right, her eyes on the black seal. Beside her, in full profile facing right, the barefoot half-orc, brick-red mane on a shaved head, stands on his bare feet with both hands holding a white cord that runs back out of the hall. Round the walls brass-faced craftsmen in aprons have all stopped work and turned to look. Brass filings and charcoal dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头头一手和下一拍（源稿第485、486行）：第五十一层的层碑叫铜臂搬上了一张比屋子还大的校准台，台沿上站着一个比别的人影高一头的，胸前挂一串印，脸叫印泥糊平了；瑞秋扑到台上拿白布和炭条拓名字，说这是名字。拿最底下那枚黑印凌空一盖照对头第二手第488行，并进来了。白线照第484行。挂印的没有脸。

nodes.name: 刻日迈步
who: the horned woman with the chisel
the coral-braided young woman holding the white line
nodes.light: flickering yellow-green brass light from ribbons of light streaming toward a far machine, one straight line of pure white running along the floor to his feet, deep bronze shadow
nodes.camera: at floor level beside the chisel, close on the fresh-cut marks and his lifting heel, the hall soaring behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the threshold of an immense round hall of brass as big as a fortress town, deep underground; its walls rise ring above ring, and long ribbons of light stream inward from every side toward a tall machine at the centre, to whose front a small human-like shape is fused, with no face to be seen at this distance. A single straight line of white light runs along the brass floor from the doorway behind us to the feet of the barefoot half-orc, who stands a few paces into the hall in full profile facing right: broad, grey-green skin, large forward-flaring ears, a short brick-red crest of hair. His left foot is planted; his right heel has just lifted off the floor to take one more step, his arms a little out for balance, his eyes fixed ahead, his jaw set. Kneeling at his feet, facing us, the horned woman with the chisel bends over the brass floor: tall, deep bronze skin, two short horns, short pale lavender hair, a folding stool strapped to her back; her left hand holds an old chisel to the floor, her right hand has just struck it with a small hammer, and beside his planted foot a short row of freshly cut marks shines in the brass. Behind them, standing on the white line and facing us, the coral-braided young woman holding the white line grips the taut line of light in both fists, braced back. Above her a huge arm of brass like a falling gate is stopped against a dented round shield held up by a stocky fighter. On the floor near the door lies one small black stamp. Brass filings and sparks of light drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第四拍（源稿第453行那一条）：娜佳拿祖父的凿子在他脚边刻下日子，刻给机器看；下一口空到了，杜戈自己把脚拔起来迈了出去，那是第十一步。瑞秋的白线从殿门直穿到杜戈脚下、凹盾举盾顶住铜臂照第二、三拍。刻下的日子只画成一排刻痕。殿当中机器上那一个是那座黄铜城自己的执政官，不是四执政，只写成很小的人形。

nodes.name: 小石片
nodes.light: soft green-gold light in a mossy underground court, a warm campfire, a small bright glint where a brass seal touches stone
nodes.camera: close at the height of his hands, the small flat stone and the seal in the middle of the frame, the camp and the cart behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a camp on the way up, in an underground court carpeted with deep green moss under a half-fallen vault, soft light coming down through the break. Six tired people are packing up beside a small fire. Sitting on a root in the foreground, facing us, is the barefoot half-orc, sixty, both temples shaved and a strip of short brick-red mane on top, his bare feet in the moss. In his left palm he holds a small flat piece of stone, the size of a hand, with a few lines of clumsy marks scratched on its upper side by a child's knife; he has turned it over, and with his right hand he is pressing a small brass travel seal down on its back. His face is gentle and tired. Beside him, in full profile facing left, the coral-braided young woman, coral-pink hair in one thick braid, holds a roll of white cloth covered in charcoal rubbings against her chest with her left arm and with her right hand points him toward a carter who waits, small, with a covered wagon at the edge of the court, its mule facing west. Behind them, small, a bull-horned woman stands a little apart, looking back the way they came, her hand at the root of one horn. Moss spores and fire sparks drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第503行）：回程过苔庭，营地里留着一块孩子们刻的小石片，写的是接到了没有；杜戈在背面按了旅印，托往西的车捎回烬灭之都。瑞秋拓的名字照二幕第486行。娜佳朝那一座厅的方向站着照二幕幕终第490行。石片上的字写成认不出的刻痕。

nodes.name: 六尖的窝
who: the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns
the fox-eared young woman with the star key
nodes.light: dusk in a deep cavern camp, one lantern on a pole, warm on a rough stone wall and on a small six-pointed hollow in it
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the east wall, close on the hollow and the offered mallet handle, the three figures above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening at the last camp before the deep, a ring of iron stakes in a great cavern, lanterns on poles. The east side of the camp is a wall of rough natural rock, and low down in it a patch of the surface has flaked away to show a small neat hollow cut in the stone: a six-rayed star shaped like a small sunburst, six thick blunt rays standing out from a round centre, with one of the six rays broken off short; it is not made of two interlocking triangles and it is not a five-pointed star. Beside the hollow, facing us, stands the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns, red hair in two braids coiled round the roots of her two straight horns, a stake-driver's leather apron: she holds a long-handled mallet upside down by its head in her right hand, offering the handle, and her left hand points at the foot of the wall. In front of her, in full profile facing right, the fox-eared young woman with the star key, twenty-two, bright orange-red hair cut short at the ears, fox ears and a fluffy tail, a map case on her back, has closed her right hand on the offered handle; in her left palm lies a small solid metal key seal of the same shape, a round centre with six thick blunt rays and one ray short, like a tiny sunburst, glowing faintly blue; it is a solid piece of metal, not an outline and not two interlocking triangles. Behind her, facing us, the broad-shouldered young man, twenty-one, so wide in the shoulder that he hides half the lantern, a sprig of laurel stuck in his collar, cranes to look at the hollow, both hands on his pack straps. Behind them, small, a dwarf with a lamp of glowing moss and a cat-eared girl with a stick of charcoal are setting down their packs. Lantern motes and rock dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第754行）：上旬八日傍晚，最后锚点，灯杆底下站着一个红头发的炎角，两根辫子盘在角根上；法丽达把打桩的锤倒过来递给莉齐，叫她自己拿锤柄在东墙根敲一下。东墙根墙皮掉了一块，底下一个窝，六个尖，一个尖缺了半截照单子第742行；第三十九枚钥印浮起一层蓝照第749行。盖文是月桂、古德蒙、纳纳照第750、751行。 11-25 第四手：头一稿墙上的窝画成五角星，手里的钥印画成两个三角叠成的六芒星（现世的宗教记号）；改成圆心伸出六道粗钝光芒、一道断短的星芒形，写明不是两个三角相叠。

nodes.name: 倒悬书馆
who: the dwarf scout with the moss lamp
nodes.light: a soft green glow from a lamp of living moss, dim blue dusk among endless shelves, pale page edges catching the light
nodes.camera: from the floor far below looking up at them standing head-down on the ceiling among the hanging shelves, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a vast library behind a wall of the deep, where the path has turned and the walkers now stand on the ceiling: shelves of books run along the ceiling like streets, and the real floor hangs far overhead with its tables and lamps upside down. Along one shelf-street three people walk, seen from below, their feet on the ceiling and their heads toward us. In the middle is the small silver-haired girl, a child with shoulder-length silver hair whose ends are damp as if from fog, misty blue eyes very wide, in a plain smock, unhurt and unafraid; her left hand trails along the spines of the books. Over her shoulders the broad-shouldered young man beside her, twenty-one, enormously wide in the shoulder, in full profile facing right, is settling an old cloak with sleeves: both his hands are on the cloak, drawing it round her, and he is bending to do it. Ahead of them, facing us, the dwarf scout with the moss lamp, an old dwarf with a great beard, holds up a glass lamp filled with softly glowing green moss in his right hand and with his left runs a finger down the edge of an open book. All along the edges of its pages short strokes have been drawn in rows, one stroke for each day, thousands of them. Further along the shelf, small, a fox-eared young woman with a map case is drawing on a sheet against her knee. Loose pages and glowing moss dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第三拍（源稿第760行）：这一天走北边的倒悬图书馆，路一拐人就站在了天花板上，书页边上画满短道，到了钟点谁敲的谁画，一道一天；露希亚一身潮气，盖文把带袖的旧斗篷披给她。露希亚是孩子，不受伤。古德蒙的苔灯照人物资料。

nodes.name: 回了一下
who: the fox-eared young woman with the star key
nodes.light: one small warm oil lamp on a stone slab near the girl, cold frost-white fungus glow from an opening on the right, pale steam in an opening at the centre, deep slate shadow
nodes.camera: low among the stone sleeping slabs, looking up at the girl under the beam as the iron bar lands, the three openings behind her, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a wide hidden hall deep underground, its floor covered with rows of stone sleeping slabs; a small iron-framed oil lamp burns on the nearest one. In the middle stands a thick stone pillar with a long beam on top reaching out to one side, and from the beam hang iron plates, pick heads and the bottoms of old cooking pots. Under it stands the small silver-haired girl, a child with shoulder-length silver hair in an oversized brown cloak whose sleeves are rolled up three times, in full profile facing right, unhurt: with a short iron bar in her right hand she has just struck the lowest pot bottom once, her left hand steadying it, her face solemn, her head cocked toward the wall on the right as if she has heard an answer. Rings of dust are jumping off the east wall at the same instant, as though something had knocked back from the other side. Behind her the far wall has three openings, and each is folding shut like the pages of a great closing book: on the left one, shelves of books hang upside down; in the middle one, a rail track slopes into steam; in the right one, a pillared court glows with frost-white mushrooms; in each a small figure stands braced against an old wooden post and does not let go. At the foot of a short stair on the right, facing us, the fox-eared young woman with the star key, orange-red hair and fox ears, kneels at a doorframe with her left palm over a small star-shaped socket and her right fist closed on a key, counting under her breath. Dust and lamp motes drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第四拍（源稿第724行那一条）：钟点到了，露希亚敲了一下，墙那一边法丽达也敲了一下，九百多年里头一回有人回了这一下；三个人都没有松手，三面墙合成了平的。莉齐在门框跟前数数照第五拍。露希亚是孩子，不受伤。三头吞层兽只画成合上的口子，不画脸。钥印只写 star-shaped。

nodes.name: 东墙一敲
who: the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns
nodes.light: the dim blue hour before the morning bell in a cavern camp, one lantern, a faint cold glow on a smooth patch of rock where a hollow used to be
nodes.camera: close along the face of the wall at the height of her ear, her cheek near the stone and the mallet handle just touching it, the waiting camp folk behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before the morning bell at the last camp before the deep, a ring of iron stakes in a great cavern, one lantern burning. At the foot of the east wall of rough rock there is a patch where the stone is perfectly smooth, as if a hollow had been there and had closed over. In front of it, in full profile facing right, stands the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns, red hair in two braids coiled round the roots of her two straight horns, a stake-driver's apron. She holds a long-handled mallet upside down in her right hand and is knocking the butt of its handle once against the smooth patch; her left hand is spread on the rock beside it, and her head is bent with one ear almost touching the wall, listening. Her face is still. Behind her a dozen camp folk have lined up in silence to do the same, each with something to knock with: a spoon, a knife hilt, a tin cup, a child's wooden sword. On a post beside the wall hang four small brass travel seals on one nail, and under them a scrap of paper is pinned with a single line of fine marks. Far back in the camp, small, a watchman has his hand on the rope of the morning bell and waits. Lantern motes and rock dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、二、五拍（源稿第777、778、781行）：诺维安下来听了一下午，说门不在了，法丽达说闩上了，是里头的人闩的；四个名字钉上未归板，蕾雅叫书记把第三句（里头还有人敲）写在了旁边；往后法丽达每回轮到最后锚点，到了那个钟点去东墙跟前敲一下，营地里的人跟着学。四枚旅印挂在营地的桩上是我借进来的（未归板在井口）。

nodes.name: 按回板上
like: the fire-horn young woman with the black-red braid and the tall blond young man
nodes.light: grey autumn daylight in a crowded commission hall, cold on porcelain-white skin, warm on a braid of black-red hair, a small gleam on brass seals coming out of pockets
nodes.camera: close at the notice board at the height of the pinned sheet, his flat hand on it in the middle of the frame, her face beside it, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn day in a crowded guild commission hall, a wall of notice boards covered with slips. On the middle board hangs one long sheet of close fine lines, and near its foot one line has been ruled round with a box. In front of it, in full profile facing left, stands the tall white-haired reckoning officer: porcelain-white skin, short lead-white hair cut very even, pale violet eyes, a small mark like a numeral cut into the bone of his brow, a dark official coat. His right hand is pressed flat on the sheet, pinning it back to the board, and his left hand is raised with two fingers up toward the crowd behind. Facing him, in full profile facing right, stands a fire-horn young woman, two short straight horns ringed at the roots with gold burn-marks, black-red hair in one thick braid, silver eyes, in a dark travelling coat: her right hand has just let go of the sheet, and her left hand is held up with all five fingers spread, asking for five days. Her jaw is set. Behind her, facing us, a tall young man with short blond hair holds an unopened leather pouch against his chest with both arms and stares at the boxed line. Behind them, small, the captains of three other parties are already taking small brass seals out of their pockets, and a young woman with dark blue-black wings and a pale young man with shaved white hair wait by the door. Dust motes and paper lint drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一到五拍（源稿第1019到1023行）：第七条写的是留一人于室内扶石；帕丽萨说这一张不接；贝内特把帕丽萨放下的约按回板上，说这一张今天按满，赏金当场添两成，排在后头的团已经在掏印；帕丽萨说给我们五天；埃兹拉怀里那只没拆的皮袋。贝内特是白骸，额骨上的号是七。黑曜誓约四个人没有立绘，照头一轮那一幅的写法，加了 like。

nodes.name: 琉璃水道
like: the fire-horn young woman with the black-red braid, the young woman with dark blue-black wings, the tall blond young man and the pale young man with shaved white hair
nodes.light: a burst of white-orange fire at a rock pillar in the middle, black water lit amber, a tube of water turned to clear hot glass, deep blue dark beyond
nodes.camera: low in the water channel just behind the fire-horn woman, looking along her fire at the bursting pillar and the two stopped currents, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in a flooded shaft where a current runs through tunnels of black rock. Where two tunnels fork, the wall between them has gone soft and vanished, and the water has split into two rushing streams. In the middle of the fork stands a pillar of rock, and it is bursting apart in a blast of white-orange fire. The two streams have crashed together round it and stopped dead, piled up against each other, and the whole length of the nearer tunnel, a hundred paces of it, has been burnt dry in an instant: its water has become a tube of clear glass still glowing at the edges. In the foreground, standing waist-deep and seen directly from behind, a fire-horn young woman, two short straight horns ringed with gold burn-marks that glow to the tips, black-red hair in one thick braid, has both her arms thrust straight out at the pillar, hands open, the fire leaving her palms. Above the left-hand stream a young woman with dark blue-black membranous wings is diving head-down with her wings half shut, and her teeth and both hands have caught the waist rope of a tall young man with short blond hair who is being swept away; he is unhurt and reaching up for her. In the right-hand stream a pale young man with shaved white hair clings with both arms to a square slab of black glassy stone, a chisel in his teeth. Flat against the far wall hangs something thin and pale, as wide as a sail and almost transparent, with no face. Drops of water and beads of hot glass fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手和下一拍（源稿第1032、1033行）：它贴上了埃兹拉和佩波当中那一道壁，壁一化，暗流分成两股，一股卷着埃兹拉往下，一股卷着佩波往淹没长廊去；她没有挑，奥列霞俯冲下去咬住埃兹拉的腰绳，帕丽萨把火烧在两条道当中的岩柱上，岩柱炸开，两股水撞在一处停了一口气，三十丈水道烧成一截干的琉璃。界蜕照第1030行写成一张帆那么大的薄东西，没有脸。四个人照头一轮那一幅的写法，加了 like。

nodes.name: 烧边
nodes.light: a ring of orange-white fire running round the edges of two black slabs at the centre, amber light spreading through the water in a shaft mouth on the left, the low oil lamps all standing straight
nodes.camera: low on the chamber floor at the corner of the slabs, looking up past the fire at the hanging stone and the man at the winch, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a low air chamber deep underground inside a drowned corridor, its walls and roof shored up by hundreds of timber props standing close like ribs. Overhead hangs a slab of grey stone as big as a town gate on four chains that run to an iron winch on the right. On the floor in the middle lie two square slabs of black glassy stone, one clapped on top of the other like the covers of a book, and something thin and pale is bulging between them, trying to push them apart. A young woman with dark blue-black membranous wings lies flat on top of the upper slab, pressing it down with her whole body, facing us. Crouched at the slabs in full profile facing right, a fire-horn young woman, two short straight horns ringed at the roots with gold burn-marks that now glow all the way to the tips, black-red hair in one thick braid, silver eyes, is breathing a narrow stream of fire along the seam; the fire has run all the way round the four edges, and the black stone is melting and setting again as it passes. Two young men kneel at the other corners with their palms flat on the stone, one tall with short blond hair, one pale with shaved white hair. At the winch on the right stands the tall white-haired reckoning officer, in full profile facing left: porcelain-white skin, short lead-white hair, his right hand resting on the winch handle, stopped, his face unreadable. Beside the winch the old horned winch-keeper, short and thick-armed, iron-blue hair streaked grey, is hooking a chain onto a corner of the black slabs with both hands. In the shaft mouth on the left the dark water is turning amber. Sparks and drops fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六、七拍（源稿第1050、1051行）：佩波把第二块石板扣上去，奥列霞拿整个身子压住，帕丽萨角根的金纹烧到了角尖，一口火沿着两块石板的边走了一圈；戈兰把绞盘的链子挂上石板的四角；贝内特的手在绞盘上停了一口气；沉水回廊的水面从墨色一路亮成了琥珀色。帕丽萨、埃兹拉、佩波、奥列霞没有立绘，照补卷_81的样子写。界蜕夹在石板当中，不画脸。壁画那一幅是前一拍（四角按印）。

nodes.name: 皮袋没拆
like: the fire-horn young woman with the black-red braid and the tall blond young man
nodes.light: warm lantern light under a giant mushroom cap, soft green glow from the caps around, gold on cups and faces
nodes.camera: at table height, close on the first cup being poured in front of the old man, the unopened pouch on the table beside it, the party behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening in a town built on the caps of giant mushrooms deep underground, lanterns strung between the caps, a tavern of planks open on all sides. A long table is crowded with forty-odd young adventurers in black-trimmed jackets, tired and loud. At the head of the table, facing us, sits the old horned winch-keeper, a short man with arms as thick as a smith's, short iron-blue hair streaked grey, two small blunt horns; both his big hands lie flat on the table, and he is looking at the cup in front of him as if he did not know what to do with it. Standing at his shoulder, in full profile facing left, a sturdy woman of forty with the same iron-blue hair pours the first cup of the evening into it from a jug held in both hands, smiling down at him. On his other side, in full profile facing right, sits a fire-horn young woman, two short straight horns ringed at the roots with gold burn-marks, black-red hair in one thick braid, her right hand raising her own cup toward him, her left arm bandaged to the elbow. Next to her a tall young man with short blond hair has set a small leather pouch on the table in front of him, still tied shut, and keeps one hand on it. Down the table, small, a young woman with dark wings is asleep on her folded arms. Lantern motes and mushroom spores drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍（源稿第1049行）：戈兰的赔金没有发；他女儿在菌伞镇请全团喝了一顿，头一杯照规矩倒给守气室的人，埃兹拉那只皮袋照旧没有拆。帕丽萨左臂缠着布是三幕烧边以后我补的，拿不准可去掉。黑曜誓约的人照头一轮那一幅的写法，加了 like。

nodes.line: 垂暮的年月·最后一扇门
nodes.name: 红灯半夜
like: the straw-haired young woman with the mill-door shield, the dwarf woman with the hammer and the cat-eared archer
nodes.light: one red signal lamp burning on a pole, a faint green glow from mushroom caps, grey half-light spilling out of a door that stands in the open
nodes.camera: low on the rim of the mushroom cap behind the four children, past the shield wedged in the door, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the middle of the night in a town built on the caps of giant mushrooms deep underground; a red signal lamp burns on a pole and nobody has come to it. At the very edge of one cap, where there is no wall and no house, stands a single wooden door in its frame, half open, and out of the gap comes a grey half-light and a slow file of dim half-melted shapes with no faces, walking toward the town. Wedged into the gap of the door is a long shield made from an old mill door, and behind it, seen directly from behind, a sturdy young woman with straw-coloured long hair tied very high with a leather cord leans her whole weight on it, both arms braced inside the shield, her boots sliding on the cap. A dwarf woman, in full profile facing right, has both fists locked in the back of her belt and is hauling her backward to keep her from being drawn through. On the left, facing us, a cat-eared archer with a tuft of white on one ear tip holds a drawn bow steady on the gap, her bow hand at its middle and her drawing hand at her jaw. In the near foreground, small and seen from behind, four children of sixteen in new jackets stand huddled together, unhurt, one of them with a hand half raised toward the door as if answering a voice, another pulling that hand down. Spores and flecks of red lamplight drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头头一手和下一拍（源稿第1125、1126行）：回响潮的头一夜，那扇门开在了菌伞镇的伞盖边上，骨谷里半化开的残响从门里往镇上走，新报名的一队四个孩子听见门里有人说话；红灯点了半夜，没有人来，头一个到的是不灭之炎，珂洛拿门板改的长盾卡住门缝，贝瑞攥着她的腰带，纳纳在旁边。孩子不受伤。不灭之炎的人照头一轮那一幅的写法，加了 like。留门的没画进这一幅。

nodes.line: 垂暮的年月·最后一扇门
nodes.name: 花雨落回
nodes.light: a rain of softly glowing petals over a dim forest of giant mushrooms and doors, cold grey light inside one open door, a faint gold where petals land
nodes.camera: low among the standing doors behind the two legends, looking up at the petals falling out of the door onto them, the dark figure beyond, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the seventeenth floor of the labyrinth, a forest of giant mushrooms in which wooden doors stand everywhere in their frames with no walls round them, hundreds of them, for miles. A rain of softly glowing petals is falling over the whole forest, and on the lintel of every door one petal has settled and holds it shut. All but one. In the middle stands a tall dark figure with two black pointed horns swept back close to its head, its face lost in shadow, a long curved blade sheathed at its back; it has lifted one hand, and behind it one door stands wide open. The petals that fall near it stream into that open door, and out of the same door, a moment later, the same petals come falling again, onto the heads of the two people who face it. On the left, in full profile facing right, stands the rose-gold-haired swordswoman, tall and slender, rose-gold hair bound back, a slim straight sword raised in her right hand with its point toward the figure, her left hand lifted to shield her eyes from her own petals. Beside her, in full profile facing right, the old map-maker, tall and thin, dark hair shot through with silver, one eye a blank white glass, holds a drawing board against his chest with his left arm and a pen stopped in mid-stroke in his right hand; on the board the lines of a map are fading as he draws them. Round them the paths between the doors, which had lain still, have begun to move again. Petals and spores drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第一、二拍（源稿第1133、1134行）：999年回响潮，名录上的两位老人下到门林，奥尔文画一张图，门林十几里的路照着图停住，伊索尔德的花雨落满了第十七层，每一扇梦门上压一瓣；留门的抬了一下手，花雨落进它身后那扇门里，又照原样从门里落了回来，落在两位老人自己头上，奥尔文再画一张，它从图上没有的一扇梦门走了。留门的照头一轮那一幅的写法，脸收在暗处。

nodes.line: 垂暮的年月·最后一扇门
nodes.name: 门板接刀
nodes.light: pale blue-green glow under giant mushroom caps going dark one by one, a white flash where the blade meets the shield, the red light of camp lanterns far behind
nodes.camera: low in the sinking moss behind the shield-bearer's heels, looking up at the blade coming down and the open door behind it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night deep underground in a forest of giant mushrooms as tall as towers, their caps glowing faintly; a line of them is toppling one after another into the distance like felled trees. Among the stalks stands one wooden door in its frame with no wall round it, flung wide open, and through it pour dim grey shapes. In front of the door stands a tall dark figure with two black pointed horns swept back close to its head, its face lost in shadow, bringing a long curved two-handed blade straight down; a scabbard carved all over with forking lines hangs at its back. The blade has landed on a long shield made from an old mill door, held overhead by a sturdy young woman who is seen directly from behind: straw-coloured long hair tied very high with a leather cord, both arms braced inside the shield, her knees bent; under her feet the moss carpet has caved into a wide round hollow, and she has not gone down. Pressed against her back, in full profile facing right, a dwarf woman holds the haft of a hammer crosswise behind the shield with both hands, sharing the blow. On the left, facing us, a cat-eared archer with a tuft of white on one ear tip has an arrow on the string, her bow hand gripping the bow at its middle, her drawing hand at her jaw. On the right a halfling man with a sack bigger than himself on his back scatters a line of white bran round the rim of the hollow with his right hand. Far behind, small, the lanterns of a town built on mushroom caps tilt sideways. Spores, splinters and white bran fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第三拍（源稿第1144行）：留门的一刀劈下来，门林的巨菌倒了十几里，珂洛的门板盾接住了，脚下的菌毯陷成一口塘，贝瑞拿锤柄横在盾后头替她分去一半力，纳纳的箭把门里出来的东西钉回门槛，奎普拖着麸皮口袋在塘边撒白线。不灭之炎四个人都没有立绘，照补卷_81写。留门的是潮照着法赫德做的那一个，脸收在暗处不画。壁画那一幅是后一拍（上闩）。

nodes.line: 垂暮的年月·最后一扇门
nodes.name: 新印
like: the straw-haired young woman with the door shield
nodes.light: low winter sun through the open door of the hall onto the plain bench, warm on paper and brass, and outside, far off, the pale pillar of light over the well
nodes.camera: at the height of the bench, close on the sheet and its two groups of seals, her hands and the clerk's, the door and the far pillar of light behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter afternoon at the door of the great seal hall of the adventurers' guild, beside the plain wooden bench worn smooth by a thousand years. On the bench, facing us, sits the pale-gold-haired guild master, short tousled pale gold hair, a shawl over her shoulders. She holds one blue-edged sheet face down on her knees: its back carries two groups of small round seal prints, a few old worn ones at the bottom and, above them, a fresh crowd of bright new ones filling the top of the page. With her right forefinger she is tapping the new seals at the top, and with her left hand she is passing the sheet to a young clerk who bends to take it in both hands. In front of the bench, facing us, stands a sturdy young woman with straw-coloured long hair tied very high with a leather cord, a bandage round her forearm, grinning; on her back hangs a long shield freshly made from a town gate door, its iron hinges still on it. Beside her, small, a fire-horn young woman with a black-red braid is handing a folded note up to a carter on a wagon that faces west. Through the hall door and across the square, far off, the tall pale pillar of light stands over the mouth of the great well, and at its very foot a short stub of light of the wrong colour, a dull red-violet, shines upward. Snowflakes and dust in the door light drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三、五拍（源稿第1152、1153、1155行）：蕾雅叫书记把这一张收好，说往后的单子照这样排，新的印在上头；珂洛的盾换了一块门板，是菌伞镇的人从镇门上卸下来送的；帕丽萨托往西的车捎了一句话，第十七层，收了；归寂月的一夜，井口守夜的人看见落进井里的光柱底下多了一截往上照的光，颜色不对。把这几样并在长凳前一个场面里，光柱底下那一截当远景。珂洛照头一轮那一幅的写法，加了 like。

notes: 11-25：这一页先写每条主线头一轮的那一幅（三幕），别的幕后补。
黑曜誓约四个人（帕丽萨、埃兹拉、佩波、奥列霞）和不灭之炎四个人（珂洛、贝瑞、纳纳、奎普）没有立绘，两条主线的各幕都照补卷_81_冒险团那几行的样子写，后几幅可以拿头一轮这一幅当 like 参考。
11-25 接手后补：空着的环、无谬之城、星形钥印的一幕、二幕、收束。空着的环收束里文森特画成靠着桥栏坐着的背影。
11-25 接手后补：第七条、最后一扇门的一幕、二幕、收束。垂暮的年月五条二十幅写齐，六页一百七十六幅场面稿全了。第七条、最后一扇门里黑曜誓约、不灭之炎的人没有立绘，五幅加了 like（拿这一条主线头一轮那一幅当认人的参考）。
